description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Pure Engine policy slice within PR A; no prerequisite dependency on PR B execution-private integration. Add a typed facts contract and code-defined Direct/Shared/Replicated strategies with validated transcript coordinates, per-message association targets, access policy hints, parent-context source order and membership lifecycle. Reject unknown provider/connector/kind, nil actor where required, inconsistent parent and mismatched connector. Provider defaults must be explicit; mention/response gating belongs to .4, not history. Test FIRST: Direct one-to-one participant grants; Shared root/thread inheritance and read order; Replicated per-message sender/recipient sets with no retroactive association, unknown mapping and collision isolation; property tests for uniqueness and membership safety. No DB persistence or Action exposure. Read Engine and Channels guides, docs/action-reuse.md/testing-approach.md; update Engine guide. No E2E authoring before human UX approval.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 Action reuse before coding: existing TranscriptHistory append/list enforces storage and access, ChannelHistoryResource.for/3 and can_read?/2 provide DB-backed direct Person grants; no strategy resolver or policy operation exists in Engine/Channels source (bounded search). Extend via local-only pure Engine history-policy behaviour plus modules, returning typed targets/access and context-source order to be consumed by .14.2/.4; do not replace or bypass TranscriptHistory and do not expose strategy as agent tool/Action. Provider mapping explicit and fail-closed: email:imap replicated; bo direct; mattermost/slack/discord/teams/telegram require trusted direct-vs-channel kind, not default from missing is_dm. API unsupported until defined. Fields in normalized facts are internally trusted after Channels bridge in .14.2; arbitrary Event/Incoming metadata is not attestation. No DB writes nor mention gating in this slice. Test first for mapping, thread inheritance, Person/grant semantics, per-message recipient isolation and property invariants. The parent .14 is split by domain: .14.1 Engine pure policy, .14.2 Channels normalization; .14.2 blocked by this typed contract.

2026-09-26 implemented test-first pure Engine typed Facts and Strategy behaviour with Direct/Shared/Replicated modules. Explicit provider/kind mapping fails closed; connector/channel/actor and parent strategy/resource scope validated; Shared thread parent requires matching persisted root; Direct thread reuses root scope; Replicated association targets only current message sender and supplied per-message recipient Person IDs (no prior-audience expansion). request transcript resolution selects actor only, separate from per-message fanout. Access policy returns required participant grant/owner hints, never an authorization result; actual reads still require TranscriptHistory persisted grants/owner. Test first uncovered missing module/resolve callback and whitespace scope, then fixed. 34 focused tests/4 properties across policy/canonical API/schema/private records, 0 failures; mix q green; staged diff check clean. No DB write, ingress wiring, new Action/tool, or feature E2E. Channels .14.2 owns trusted normalization, independent recipient evidence and caller attestation.

2026-09-26 commit 969458673 pushed as draft stacked PR #812 on #811. Focused 34 tests/4 properties and mix q green; no new-feature E2E. Parent .14 remains open until Channels-normalized facts .14.2 and integration checks complete. The type is internal policy input, not attestation or an authorization grant.
